title: Clean HTML output
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe 🙏**

The current HTML output of InstantSearch.js contains whitespaces, which makes it messy.

![before](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6137112/45218734-f0dc0100-b2a8-11e8-963a-00d1f64d708a.png)

**Describe the solution you'd like 🤔**

By trimming the templates [once compiled by Hogan](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/lib/utils.js#L182), we could clean the HTML output by removing the whitespaces.

```diff
 return hogan
     .compile(template, compileOptions)
     .render({
       ...data,
       helpers: transformedHelpers,
     })
+    .trim();
```

![after](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6137112/45218819-2d0f6180-b2a9-11e8-9bbc-49a28cb6e0df.png)

**Describe alternatives you've considered ✨**

We could also use [Handlebars' whitespace control](http://handlebarsjs.com/expressions.html#whitespace-control) features but I didn't get this to work.

**Additional context**

If we go for this in InstantSearch 3, we'd need to apply this change after having merged the InstantSearch.css specs because it'd also clean up some snapshots.

```diff
 <div
   dangerouslySetInnerHTML={
     Object {
-      "__html": "  $",
+      "__html": "$",
     }
   }
 />
 <div
   dangerouslySetInnerHTML={
     Object {
-      "__html": "  ",
+      "__html": "",
      }
   }
 />
```
